title: Numerical evidence for A Game-Theoretic MPC Planner for Cooperative and Adversarial Drone Coordination
description: Retained evidence for five studies: controlled equilibria, scaling, cooperative flight, pursuit–evasion and laboratory tracking. Includes failed and approximate candidates, the matched damping comparison, checksums and independent-verification inputs. Weight-comparison and automatic weight-calibration studies are excluded; fixed objective weights remain in experiment configurations. Requires the separately distributed MIT-licensed software.
